title: For CLI-only slices, say in the UI pass brief that the 80x24, 120x40 and ascii renders are identical and allow one file per view

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The ui reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261125-021106-86c7, project ork, item S261:

For CLI-only slices, say in the UI pass brief that the 80x24, 120x40 and ascii renders are identical and allow one file per view

Evidence: S261 changes only CLI text, which does not depend on width; 5 views needed 15 identical files.
